reconcile.note: Gill limits Jesus's denial of judging to his present role, since all judgment remains reserved to him for a future day.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Rudolf Bultmann traced John's futurist judgment sayings to an ecclesiastical redactor layered over an evangelist who already located judgment in the present response to Jesus's word.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Rudolf Bultmann (1941), The Gospel of John: A Commentary.

sides.snippet: he has given all judgment to the Son
sides.verseText: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
